correctness.rationale: For the specified cyclic 12-vertex icosahedral graph an antipodal pair (u,bar u) has disjoint closed neighborhoods partitioning V. Sets {u,bar u,v,w} with v adjacent u and w adjacent bar u are paired dominated and matched. No 2-set dominates. Complete test of all 30 initial edges and 21 disjoint second edges proves every feasible matched 4-set contains an antipodal pair, so 6*25 minus 15 duplicate two-pair states =135, subclasses 60/60/15. Independently enumerated all C(12,4)=495 four-subsets and reconstructed reconfiguration graph on 135 valid states. Slide 360 edges, all ecc six; jump 720 edges, all ecc four. Exact finite graph proof, no general graph-family claim.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Teshima proves universal realizability of gamma-pr reconfiguration graphs only on purpose-built hosts; it does not imply the exact graph of one fixed icosahedron. Triangular/Kneser host theorems differ.
